grading.why: Stage 02 gutter-splits the spread; Stage 04 orders each half independently.
grading.subpage_coverage: ONLY the RIGHT subpage (p.105, Honduras) is graded — the left subpage (p.104, Hawai'i) carries exactly ONE figure and so cannot discriminate. See gt/en_coins_02.blocks.json for the same statement.
grading.anchor_match: Token overlap anywhere in the block.
grading.primary_invariants: Third ≥2-figure SIDE-SET grouping subpage. It carries one property the other two do not: the corner-label recognizer READS A NUMBER OFF A COIN. Measured 2026-08-18, pipeline.figure_label returns 4 for the Fig. 104 plate — there is no such number printed anywhere on the page, it is coin surface detail. That is a false positive against figure_label's stated 'zero wrong reads' invariant, on the first non-Italian page it has ever been run on. It matters here because a recovered figure number used to switch the whole subpage into 'this book prints figure numbers' mode, which suppressed the geometry arm for every numbered caption on the page.
